ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.apply_two_la.statement: Let $\Omega$ be a measure space with measure $\mu$, and let $G$ be a measurable space. Let $Z_1,Z_2,Z_3,Z_4:\Omega\to G$ be measurable functions such that the family $(Z_1,Z_2,Z_3,Z_4)$ is jointly independent with respect to $\mu$, and let $\varphi:G\to G\to G$ be a function whose uncurried form $G\times G\to G$, $(a,b)\mapsto \varphi(a,b)$, is measurable. Then the family of three functions $Z_1$, $Z_2$ and $\omega\mapsto \varphi(Z_3(\omega),Z_4(\omega))$ (all $\Omega\to G$) is jointly independent with respect to $\mu$.
